comment:
* Monitors the device and ICC storage, and sends the appropriate events.
 *
 * This code was formerly part of {@link SMSDispatcher}, and has been moved
 * into a separate class to support instantiation of multiple SMSDispatchers on
 * dual-mode devices that require support for both 3GPP and 3GPP2 format messages.

variables.name: MAX_RETRIES
variables.comment: Maximum number of times to retry memory status reporting

variables.name: EVENT_REPORT_MEMORY_STATUS_DONE
variables.comment: Memory status reporting is acknowledged by RIL

variables.name: mContext
variables.comment: Context from phone object passed to constructor.

variables.name: mWakeLock
variables.comment: Wake lock to ensure device stays awake while dispatching the SMS intent.

variables.name: mPhone
variables.comment: it is use to put in to extra value for SIM_FULL_ACTION and SMS_REJECTED_ACTION

variables.name: WAKE_LOCK_TIMEOUT
variables.comment:
* Hold the wake lock for 5 seconds, which should be enough time for
     * any receiver(s) to grab its own wake lock.

methods.name: public void sendMemoryStatusOverride(boolean isStorageAvailable)
methods.comment:
* Overriding of the Memory Status by the TestApi and send the event to Handler to test
     * the RP-SMMA feature
     * @param isStorageAvailable boolean value specifies the MemoryStatus to be
     * sent to Handler

methods.name: public void clearMemoryStatusOverride()
methods.comment: * reset Memory Status change made by {@link #sendMemoryStatusOverride}

methods.name: public void handleMessage(Message msg)
methods.comment:
* Handles events coming from the phone stack. Overridden from handler.
     * @param msg the message to handle

methods.name: private void handleIccFull()
methods.comment:
* Called when SIM_FULL message is received from the RIL. Notifies the default SMS application
     * that SIM storage for SMS messages is full.

methods.name: public boolean isStorageAvailable()
methods.comment: Returns whether or not there is storage available for an incoming SMS.
